items.source: Create a new expression parsing exception.
items.translation: 创建一个新的表达式解析异常。

items.source: position - the position in the expression string where the problem occurred
items.translation: position - 问题在表达式字符串中发生的位置

items.source: message - description of the problem that occurred
expressionString - the expression string that could not be parsed
items.translation: expressionString - 无法解析的表达式字符串

items.source: Represent an exception that occurs during expression parsing.
items.translation: 表示在表达式解析期间发生的异常。

items.source: cause - the underlying cause of this exception
